data.title: Qing Lian Jian Xian Zhuan
data.synopsis: Introduction: In the world of Cangyun, immortals and demons are constantly fighting against each other. Xu Changqing was born in Qinglian Sword Valley, and he wanted to be a sword fairy, but the good times didn't last long. The Ninth Demon General of Cangyue Palace invaded Qinglian Sword Valley. Grandpa Xu Changqing sacrificed. lost. Later, Kunlun Taibai Sword Immortal Qiu Wuya arrived, repelled the demon gate, and brought Xu Changqing and Mu Zixun to Kunlun. All the real people in Kunlun wanted to seize the Qinglian Emperor Sword, but Qiu Wuya stopped them. Xu Changqing awakened his celestial spirit "Chaos Gathering Spirit Monument", and was accepted as a disciple by Qiu Wuya. In the Immortal Sword Competition, Xu Changqing defeated Xia Qinghou to win the crown and was qualified to enter the forbidden area of ​​Kunlun. In order to find the fountain of immortality that could revive his grandfather, Xu Changqing chose to enter the dangerous forbidden area of ​​Kunlun.

data.title: Shanhai Jihui
data.synopsis:
In the future, with the increasing number of natural disasters and disasters from the universe, a mysterious organization called "Shanhai Jihui" appeared, intending to destroy and replace contemporary human beings. The protagonist, Lei Qi, joins the "Titanium" exoskeleton armored combat team, and has a multi-faceted confrontation with this mysterious technological organization. Through step-by-step decryption, he discovered that the human dream is actually a window to fully access the entire universe, so he revolved around the reality and the quadrant. The exploration of the world and the confrontation between civilizations of different ages began... 

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

data.title: Pi Zhe Lang Pi de Yang
data.synopsis:
Online novelist Lai Xiaoguang accidentally enters a virtual world called "The Hand of God." In this fantastical world, she becomes a werewolf named Da Niu and gets caught up in a case involving the theft of national treasures. To investigate the truth, she is forced to embark on a journey with the sheep king Wangcai.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
data.background: Adaptation of Hei Quan (黑圈) and Bai Dian's (白点) Chinese webtoon of the same title.

data.title: Nunchi Eobsneun Dolsoe
data.synopsis:
Haeun is a nobleman who falls hard for Dullseh, his gorgeous, but extremely clueless manservant. Dullseh's impressive build reminds Haeun of the sexy men from gay erotica that he loves so much. Exams and career ambitions be damned—he just can't get Dullseh out of his mind! Silly hijinks ensue as Haeun will do whatever it takes to lure the hunky Dullseh into his bedchamber and possibly... his heart?!

(Source: Tapas Media)

data.title: Ni Tian Zhan Ji
data.synopsis:
Wu Ran, known as the number one good-for-nothing, accidentally activated the Sacred Soul Dice System, a treasure of the universe, while severely injured in battle. This granted him strange and wondrous divine dice skills, allowing him to rescue his junior uncle and defeat the female cultivator Ni Sha. However, unexpectedly, Ni Sha developed feelings for him and sought to capture him and bring him back to her sect. Ni Sha, in alliance with the White Dragon King, launched an attack on Earth's city, aiming to obtain the Sacred Soul Dice. Ultimately, Wu Ran defeats Ni Sha and protects Earth's city.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
